t: Lesson 10 — Step 8: the gates, the divert conveyor, the boxes and the shredder
html:
In the app

Guided mode’s lesson 10 is this chapter: it checks that this lesson’s tags are made, that S8_Sort exists, is called from MainRoutine and verifies, and then watches the line while you run it and ticks each result as it happens:

  • The scrap gate fires on a broken bottle
  • The divert gate fires on a small bottle
  • A small bottle reaches the packer's lower lane (Lower_Count)
  • The shredder runs with a box under the chute

Two gates, and the machinery below them. The gate rungs are written in the during-the-dwell frame (qualified by Dwell.TT, the timer timing), so they read the bits for bottles standing on the belt now: Broken 11 at the scrap gate; Exist 20, Large 19, Broken 18 at the divert gate. Add the JSR and write:

The rungs

How it fits together

Rung 0: a broken bottle at the scrap gate, or one the camera failed (Reject bit 0, step 15) → the arm swings it off the deck and it drops into the shredder hopper. Rung 1: a small, unbroken bottle the camera passed at the divert gate → down the catch incline to the divert conveyor; large bottles carry on to the end. The Exist bit stops the gate firing at empty slots at start-up; the Broken bit stops it firing at the empty slot a scrapped bottle left behind, because its Exist bit is still set.

Rung 2 is the divert conveyor. It carries the small bottles on under the case packer to its lower lane, a stop and a buffer of eight at the end of the conveyor, where the packer’s head comes down for them (step 12). While there is room the bottles roll straight into the lane. When the lane is full (Lower_Full) the next bottle waits at the stop and the conveyor should not go on running under it: the rung keeps the conveyor running until a bottle reaches the stop eye LS12, then stops it, so the bottles close up nose to tail behind the stop. It is the accumulation pattern of every conveyor that feeds a machine: [XIO(Lower_Full),XIO(LS12)] reads room in the lane, or nothing at the eye yet.

Rung 3 runs the box conveyor until a box reaches LS10 under the chute, and again once the box is full to carry it out and bring the next one. Rung 4 runs the shredder only with an empty box in position and a bottle waiting in the hopper.

Why the dwell frame? A gate arm acts on whatever is standing at the gate. The registers shift at the end of the dwell, before the belt moves; a rung that fired on the shifted bit would swing the arm while the previous bottle still stands there and push the wrong one. Qualifying with Dwell.TT fires the arm only while the belt is still and the bits describe the bottles in front of it.

Run it

Start the line with the Side view on the grinder. A broken bottle reaches the scrap gate; the arm swings, the bottle drops into the hopper; the shredder waits until a box is under the chute, then runs, glass falls into the box and the IN BOX count rises; when the box is full the box conveyor carries it out and brings the next. Small bottles go down the incline and ride the divert conveyor to the packer’s lower lane; large ones run on to the packer’s deck infeed. Until step 12 is written nothing packs them, so both fill up: watch the lower lane fill, the next small bottle stop at LS12 and the divert conveyor stop with it.

Try it

Take XIC(Dwell.TT) off rung 1 and watch which bottle the arm pushes. Take XIO(LS12) off rung 2 and watch the divert conveyor stop the moment the lane fills, with the last bottles strung out along it.

rungs.head: S8_Sort · Rung 0
rungs.comment: SCRAP: while the belt stands still (Dwell timing) Broken bit 11 is the bottle at the scrap gate; Reject bit 0 is a bottle the camera failed, no cap, no label or short, at the same place. SCRAP: while the belt stands still (Dwell timing) Broken bit 11 is the bottle at the scrap gate; the arm swings it off the raised belt and it drops into the shredder hopper below. The gate works during the dwell on purpose: the registers shift at the end of the dwell, and an arm that fired after the shift would push the bottle still standing at the gate, not the one the register names

pred.q: Dwell.TT is on, Broken[0].11 is on and Reject[0].0 is on. What does the rung do?
pred.a: The rung is true: Scrap_Gate is on.

rungs.words: When Dwell.TT (the timing bit of Dwell: Belt stopped: sensors read, feeder drops a bottle) is on and either (Broken[0].11 (Broken bottle (LogixPro B3:30). During the dwell: filler 4, capper 7, scrap gate 11, divert gate 18; after the shift one bit higher) is on) or (Reject[0].0 (Bad bottle (the camera found no cap, no label or a short fill), one bit per stop from the stop past the camera. During the dwell: scrap gate 0, divert gate 7; after the shift one bit higher) is on), the rung turns Scrap_Gate (LogixPro O:2/4 · Scrap gate: swings a bottle into the grinder) on (and off whenever the rung is false).
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Dwell.TT) Examine If Closed asks: true when Dwell.TT is on.
  2. A branch of 2 parallel paths: power gets through if any one of them is true.
    Path 1
    1. XIC(Broken[0].11) Examine If Closed asks: true when Broken[0].11 is on.
    Path 2
    1. XIC(Reject[0].0) Examine If Closed asks: true when Reject[0].0 is on.
  3. OTE(Scrap_Gate) Output Energize does: turns Scrap_Gate on (and off whenever the rung is false). Every scan it writes the rung state: true on, false off.

rungs.head: S8_Sort · Rung 1
rungs.comment: DIVERT: a small, unbroken, passed bottle at the divert gate (Exist bit 20, not Large 19, not Broken 18, not Reject 7; a rejected one went to the shredder at the scrap gate). DIVERT: a small, unbroken bottle at the divert gate (Exist bit 20, not Large 19, not Broken 18, all in the dwell frame) is swung off the raised belt and rolls down the catch incline onto the divert conveyor. Large bottles carry on to the end of the line. The Broken bit matters: a broken bottle was already scrapped, but its Exist bit is still set, so without it the arm would fire at an empty slot
rungs.words: When Dwell.TT (the timing bit of Dwell: Belt stopped: sensors read, feeder drops a bottle) is on, Exist[0].20 (Bottle present, one bit per stop (LogixPro B3:10). During the dwell: filler 6, capper 9, scrap gate 13, divert gate 20; after the shift (Dwell.DN) one bit higher) is on, Large[0].19 (Large bottle (LogixPro B3:20). During the dwell: filler 5, capper 8, scrap gate 12, divert gate 19; after the shift one bit higher) is off, Broken[0].18 (Broken bottle (LogixPro B3:30). During the dwell: filler 4, capper 7, scrap gate 11, divert gate 18; after the shift one bit higher) is off and Reject[0].7 (Bad bottle (the camera found no cap, no label or a short fill), one bit per stop from the stop past the camera. During the dwell: scrap gate 0, divert gate 7; after the shift one bit higher) is off, the rung turns Divert_Gate (LogixPro O:2/5 · Divert gate: swings a bottle onto the divert conveyor) on (and off whenever the rung is false).
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Dwell.TT) Examine If Closed asks: true when Dwell.TT is on.
  2. XIC(Exist[0].20) Examine If Closed asks: true when Exist[0].20 is on.
  3. XIO(Large[0].19) Examine If Open asks: true when Large[0].19 is off.
  4. XIO(Broken[0].18) Examine If Open asks: true when Broken[0].18 is off.
  5. XIO(Reject[0].7) Examine If Open asks: true when Reject[0].7 is off.
  6. OTE(Divert_Gate) Output Energize does: turns Divert_Gate on (and off whenever the rung is false). Every scan it writes the rung state: true on, false off.

rungs.head: S8_Sort · Rung 2
rungs.comment: DIVERT CONVEYOR: runs with the line and carries the small bottles to the packer's lower lane. When that lane is full (Lower_Full) it keeps running only until the next bottle reaches the stop eye LS12, then stops, so the bottles close up at the stop instead of riding against it. It starts again the moment the packer takes four

pred.q: Line_Run is off, Lower_Full is on and LS12 is off. What does the rung do?
pred.a: The rung is false: Divert_Conveyor is off. It stops at XIC(Line_Run).

rungs.words: When Line_Run (Seal-in run bit (LogixPro B3:0/0)) is on and either (Lower_Full (Packer lower lane full: small bottles arriving now wait at the stop) is off) or (LS12 (Stop eye at the end of the divert conveyor, just before the packer lower lane) is off), the rung turns Divert_Conveyor (LogixPro O:2/2 · Divert conveyor for large bottles) on (and off whenever the rung is false).

rungs.comment: SHREDDER: only with an empty box in position and a bottle waiting in the hopper. Each ground bottle goes up the scrap lift and drops into the box; Box_Full comes in at the Bottles per box setting (4)

pred.a: The rung is true: Grinder is on.
